settings.adminOnly: These settings are visible to administrators only.
settings.effortHint: Higher = more thorough and slower. "Off" is the fast default.
settings.fastModeBusy: (fast mode busy right now – Crea answers at normal speed)
settings.fastModeHint: Same model, faster output. Only available on Opus models, and answers cost twice as much. Where it is unavailable, Crea automatically answers at normal speed.
settings.fastModeRefused: (fast mode refused: {detail} – Crea answers at normal speed)
settings.matchingChangedElsewhere: Not saved: somebody else moved the switch in the meantime. What you see now is the stored state.
settings.matchingKeyingHint: Crea works out the words each matching entry can be found under. It costs per entry: after switching on, Crea works through the entries that have no words, up to a hundred per pass and about a pass a minute, until the backlog is gone. Switching off takes effect after the batch that is running — at most ten more entries.
settings.modelHint: Leave empty = default model ({model}). You can type a new model directly.
settings.sectionMatchingHint: No model choice here. Keying runs on the same model for every community — otherwise two servers coin two words for one thing, and their members stop finding each other.
settings.sectionModerationHint: Model, effort level and fast mode apply to every moderator at once.
settings.testInactive: The Anthropic API is not active (no key configured).
settings.title: Crea settings
settings.unavailable: The settings are not loaded yet. Saving and testing stay disabled until the values from the server are known.
